mapper.sql: encode(ST_AsEWKB(ST_Multi(ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Force2D( CASE WHEN ST_SRID(${col}) = 0 THEN ST_SetSRID(${col}, 4326) ELSE ST_Transform(${col}, 4326) END), 3))), 'hex')
CASE WHEN ${col} IS NOT NULL THEN trunc(${col})::bigint END
mapper.select: SELECT CASE municipalityid WHEN ${id} THEN #{code} END AS municipality_code, municipalityid AS municipality_id, nameen AS name_en, namear AS name_ar, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.municipality} WHERE municipalityid IN (${id})

SELECT municipalityname || '-' || districtid AS district_key, municipalityname AS municipality_code, districtid AS district_id, objectid AS src_objectid, nameenglish AS name_en, namearabic AS name_ar, namepopularenglish AS popular_name_en, population, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.district} WHERE districtid IS NOT NULL AND municipalityname IS NOT NULL

SELECT municipality || '-' || districtid || '-' || communityid AS community_key, municipality || '-' || districtid AS district_key, municipality AS municipality_code, CASE WHEN districtid ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN districtid::int END AS district_id, communityid AS community_id, objectid AS src_objectid, communitynameeng AS name_en, communitynameara AS name_ar, commpopnameeng AS popular_name_en, comnamecompositeeng AS composite_name_en, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.community} WHERE communityid IS NOT NULL AND districtid IS NOT NULL

SELECT gisid AS plot_key, gisid, plotid AS plot_id, plotnumber AS plot_number, elms_plotid AS elms_plot_id, coalesce(nullif(municipalityeng, ''), municipalityname) AS src_municipality, districtid AS src_district_id, districteng AS src_district_en, communityid AS src_community_id, communityeng AS src_community_en, calculatedarea AS area_sqm, plannedareametric AS planned_area_sqm, construction_status, servicestatus AS service_status, planningstatus AS planning_status, status AS plot_status, primaryuseengdesc AS primary_use, elms_parentlanduse_e AS parent_land_use, elms_landusename_e AS land_use, secuseeng AS secondary_use, ownershiptype AS ownership_type, elms_allocationstatus AS allocation_status, investment_name, devcode, devcode_category, devcode_far, devcode_maxgfa AS devcode_max_gfa, maxallowableheights AS max_heights, zonetpss AS zone_tpss, sectortpss AS sector_tpss, projectid AS project_id, permit_lasttype AS permit_last_type, permit_lastdate AS permit_last_date, canceldate AS cancel_date, modifieddate AS modified_date, datareceiveddate AS data_received_date, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.plot} WHERE gisid IS NOT NULL AND shape IS NOT NULL

SELECT coalesce('udm-' || buildinginternalid, 'udm-o' || objectid) AS building_key, 'udm' AS source, objectid AS udm_objectid, buildingid AS building_id, buildinginternalid AS building_internal_id, gisid, elms_plotid AS elms_plot_id, nameenglish AS name_en, namearabic AS name_ar, physicalstatus AS physical_status, primaryusagetype AS primary_usage_type, primaryuseengdesc AS primary_use, secondaryusagetype AS secondary_usage_type, buildingnumberoffloors AS floors_count, buildingheight AS height_m, completiondate AS completion_date, demolitiondate AS demolition_date, startdate AS start_date, permitid AS permit_id, constructionsiteid AS construction_site_id, is_bdms, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.building} WHERE shape IS NOT NULL

SELECT || '-' || trunc(floorid)::bigint AS floor_key, trunc(floorid)::bigint AS floor_id, AS bdms_building_id, AS bdms_municipality, floornumber AS floor_number, floor_baseheight AS base_height_m, floorheight AS floor_height_m, area_sqm, bldg_buildingstatus AS building_status, plots_primaryuseeng AS plot_primary_use, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.floors} WHERE floorid IS NOT NULL

SELECT || '-' || trunc(unitid)::bigint AS unit_key, trunc(unitid)::bigint AS unit_id, AS floor_id, AS bdms_building_id, AS bdms_municipality, unitnumber AS unit_number, unittype AS unit_type, unitusagetype AS usage_type, unitclassification AS classification, unitcategory AS category, unitarea AS area_sqm, unitnumbedroom AS bedrooms, unitnumbathroom AS bathrooms, unitbalconiesarea AS balcony_area_sqm, floornumber AS floor_number, floor_baseheight AS base_height_m, floorheight AS floor_height_m, bldg_buildingstatus AS building_status, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.units} WHERE unitid IS NOT NULL
